topic_id.description: One canonical topic id from the subject taxonomy.

hint1.description: Orients to the concept. Never names or implies the answer.

hint2.description: Points at the decisive feature or rules out the weakest options. Still does not give the answer.

hint3.description: Brings the student to the final step. They must still make the choice themselves.

solution.description: Plain text, no markdown. Structured with line breaks and plain labels.
